$note: Curated master-data dependency graph, keyed by canonical object type. `required` = other top-level objects that MUST exist (be loaded) BEFORE this object — the authoritative load-order prerequisites from the CMF Business-Data user guide's 'Sequence Of Steps' section (see masterdata_docs/guide-dependencies.md). `optional` = soft/optional prerequisites the user may include (the guide's optional 'Sequence' steps + notable references). Composition SUB-SHEETS (BOMProducts, DataCollectionParameters, StorageBin, FlowStructures, the *Context tables, ...) are NOT here — they come from composition-overrides.json via getComposition(). EXCLUDED by design: Change Set (versioning, not a loadable row) and Material (transactional/runtime, not master data). The 9 MVP objects (Step, Service, Resource, DataCollection, Product, BOM, Checklist, Document, ShiftDefinition) are guide-sourced; Flow + the location hierarchy (Area/Facility/Site) are retained from the earlier docs-seeded model.
